text:
料理は美味しいけれど、雰囲気は少し残念。

料理は全体的にオーソドックスなビストロ料理という印象で、どれも普通に美味しくいただけました。旅行中に洋食やワインが飲みたくなったときには使いやすいお店だと思います。

ただ、ワインはダナンのほかのお店と比べても少し高めに感じました。ワインと料理をいろいろ楽しみたいと思っていたので、その点は少し残念。

また、訪れた日は2階からカラオケ大会のようなかなり大きな歌声が聞こえてきました。同じお店のスペースなのか別のお店なのかは分かりませんが、食事中もかなり音が響いていて、落ち着いて食事を楽しみたい私には少し気になりました。

料理自体は美味しかったので、もう少し静かな環境で食事ができれば、より満足度が高かったと思います。
textTranslated:
The food was delicious, but the atmosphere was a little disappointing.

The food was generally standard bistro cuisine, and everything was quite tasty. It's a convenient place to go if you're craving Western food and wine during your trip.

However, the wine seemed a bit pricey compared to other places in Da Nang. I was hoping to enjoy a variety of wines and dishes, so that was a slight disappointment.

Also, on the day I visited, there was very loud singing coming from the second floor, like a karaoke competition. I don't know if it was from the same restaurant or a different establishment, but the noise was quite loud even during my meal, which was a bit bothersome for me as I wanted to enjoy my meal in peace.

The food itself was delicious, so I think I would have been even more satisfied if the dining environment had been quieter.

text:
Hôm qua mình dùng bữa tại Dom Bistro sau khi đọc khá nhiều review tích cực nên cũng có nhiều kỳ vọng.
Ấn tượng đầu tiên là không gian ấm cúng, đẹp và nguyên liệu nhìn chung khá chất lượng. Tuy nhiên, trải nghiệm phục vụ và cách lên món lại khiến mình hơi thất vọng.
Mình gọi hàu và sò điệp làm khai vị, sau đó là steak và T-bone cho món chính. Hàu được mang ra trước, nhưng phải khoảng 10–15 phút sau mới có sò điệp, trong khi người đi cùng mình gần như đã ăn xong phần khai vị. Điều đáng tiếc hơn là mình mới ăn được miếng sò điệp thứ hai thì nhân viên đã mang steak ra. Mình phải nhờ họ mang vào lại vì chưa ăn xong khai vị. Kết quả là khi steak được phục vụ lần thứ hai, món ăn không còn ở trạng thái ngon nhất nữa.
Về món ăn, hàu được chế biến theo cách đổ bỏ phần nước biển tự nhiên bên trong, làm mất đi vị mặn ngọt đặc trưng mà mình rất thích. Steak được nướng đúng độ chín yêu cầu, nhưng lại thiếu mùi thơm hấp dẫn của thịt bò nướng, nên cảm giác chưa thật sự trọn vẹn.
Tóm lại, Dom Bistro có không gian đẹp, nguyên liệu tốt và rất nhiều tiềm năng. Tuy nhiên, mình nghĩ nhà hàng nên cải thiện quy trình lên món và sự phối hợp của nhân viên phục vụ để trải nghiệm của khách được chỉn chu hơn. Chỉ cần khắc phục những điểm này thì mình tin nơi đây sẽ xứng đáng với những lời khen mà nhiều người đã dành cho.
Hy vọng góp ý của mình sẽ giúp nhà hàng hoàn thiện hơn, vì mình luôn mong những nơi làm ăn nghiêm túc sẽ ngày càng tốt hơn.
textTranslated:
Yesterday I had a meal at Dom Bistro after reading many positive reviews, so I had high expectations.

My first impression was that the space was cozy, beautiful, and the ingredients were generally quite high quality. However, the service and the way the dishes were served left me a little disappointed.
I ordered oysters and scallops as appetizers, followed by steak and T-bone for the main course. The oysters were brought out first, but it took about 10-15 minutes for the scallops to arrive, while my companion had almost finished the appetizers. Even worse, I had only eaten the second piece of scallop when the staff brought out the steak. I had to ask them to take it back because I hadn't finished the appetizer. As a result, when the steak was served a second time, it wasn't at its best.
Regarding the food, the oysters were prepared by discarding the natural seawater inside, which deprived them of the characteristic salty-sweet flavor that I really liked. The steak was grilled to the desired doneness, but lacked the appealing aroma of grilled beef, leaving the experience somewhat incomplete.

In short, Dom Bistro has a beautiful ambiance, good ingredients, and a lot of potential. However, I think the restaurant should improve its food preparation process and the coordination of its service staff to create a more polished customer experience. If these points are addressed, I believe the restaurant will live up to the praise it has received.

Hopefully, my feedback will help the restaurant improve, as I always hope that businesses that operate seriously will get better and better.

text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 值得推薦的一家餐廳！

第一次來到這家餐廳用餐，就留下了非常好的印象。首先，整體裝潢與用餐氛圍真的很舒服，很有質感，不管是約會、聚餐或商務用餐都很適合。

很幸運當天遇到了老闆本人，老闆非常熱情、親切，也很專業地幫我們推薦了一款搭餐的酒。原本只是抱著試試看的心情，沒想到真的非常好喝，和餐點搭配得恰到好處，讓整體用餐體驗更加分。

餐點方面一定要大力推薦牛排！肉質非常好，熟度掌握得恰到好處，煙燻香氣與料理技巧都非常出色。以這樣的品質，如果是在台灣，我認為至少是七、八百元以上等級的牛排，這裡的價格真的非常超值。

披薩也讓我很驚艷，是我最喜歡的薄脆餅皮，口感酥脆得像餅乾一樣，但又保有豐富的醬料與起司香氣，每一口都很有層次，完全不是一般普通的披薩。

另外，這裡的服務也很值得稱讚。服務人員不會一直打擾客人，也不會過度服務，而是默默觀察客人的需求，在適當的時候提供協助。例如桌面需要整理時，他們會主動幫忙收走用過的紙巾，很多小細節都做得非常到位，讓人覺得很舒服。

現在我終於知道，為什麼這家餐廳在 Google 上有這麼多好評，真的不是沒有原因。無論是餐點品質、服務、環境還是價格，都讓人覺得物超所值。

如果想找一家適合約會、慶祝、聚餐，甚至商務宴客的餐廳，我會毫不猶豫推薦這一家。下次來，我一定還會再訪！
textTranslated:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ A highly recommended restaurant!

My first time dining at this restaurant left a very good impression. First of all, the overall decor and dining atmosphere are very comfortable and sophisticated, suitable for dates, gatherings, or business meals.

I was lucky enough to meet the owner himself that day. He was very warm and friendly, and professionally recommended a wine to pair with our meal. I was just trying it out, but it was surprisingly delicious and paired perfectly with the food, enhancing the overall dining experience.

As for the food, I highly recommend the steak! The meat was of excellent quality, cooked to perfection, and the smoky aroma and cooking technique were outstanding. With this quality, I think it would cost at least 700-800 NTD in Taiwan, making the price here incredibly good value.

The pizza also surprised me. It had my favorite thin, crispy crust, with a texture as crisp as a biscuit, yet retaining a rich sauce and cheesy aroma. Every bite was layered and delightful, unlike any ordinary pizza.

Furthermore, the service here is also commendable. The staff are neither overly intrusive nor overly attentive; instead, they quietly observe guests' needs and offer assistance when appropriate. For example, when the table needs tidying, they proactively collect used tissues. Many small details are handled very well, making the experience very comfortable.

Now I finally understand why this restaurant has so many positive reviews on Google—it's truly worth it. Whether it's the food quality, service, ambiance, or price, it offers exceptional value for money.

If you're looking for a restaurant suitable for dates, celebrations, gatherings, or even business dinners, I would recommend this place without hesitation. I will definitely visit again next time!

text: 한국인한테 잘 안유명하면서도 스테이크 가격이 나쁘지않고 굴 후기도 좋아서 마지막날 저녁에 예약후 방문했습니다. 수프나 굴, 볶음밥은 맛있었는데 T본 스테이크,양고기 스테이크가 나오는데 40분이 걸렸고 심지어 식어있었습니다. 언제나오냐고 직원한테 물으니 곧 나온다하고 가져온건데 식어있는건 도대체 이유가 뭔지 모르겠고, 레스팅하려고 둔것도 아닐텐데 이해가 잘 안갑니다. 클레임걸고싶었으나 어글리코리안 소리 들을것같기도해서 참았습니다. 식어있는것 뿐만 아니라 T본은 그나마 나았지만 양갈비는 거의 한쪽면만 구워놓고 한쪽은 마이야르는 커녕 거의 생고기상태로 가져다주셨습니다. 미디움웰던 굽기로 부탁했는데.. 만약 그 굽기가 맞다면(절대 아니겠지만) 나오는데 40분이 걸렸으면 안될겁니다. 한국인 차별인가 싶기도하고 솔직히 잘 모르겠습니다. 가격은 한국에 비해 월등히 싸지만, 저라면 다시는 방문안할것같습니다. 굴은 후기대로 크기도 크고 맛이 좋았습니다.
textTranslated: Although it's not well-known among Koreans, the steak prices were reasonable, and the oysters had good reviews, so I made a reservation and visited on my last night. The soup, oysters, and fried rice were delicious, but the T-bone steak and lamb steak took 40 minutes to arrive, and they were even cold. I asked the staff when it would be ready, and they said it would be coming soon, but I couldn't understand why it was cold. They didn't even let it rest, so I couldn't understand. I wanted to complain, but I held back, afraid they'd accuse me of being "ugly Korean." Not only was it cold, but while the T-bone was somewhat better, the lamb ribs were almost cooked on one side, and the other side was practically raw, not even Maillard-cooked. I asked for medium-well, but if that's the doneness I was looking for (which I doubt), it shouldn't have taken 40 minutes. I wonder if it's discrimination against Koreans, but honestly, I'm not sure. The prices are significantly cheaper than in Korea, but I don't think I'd visit again. The oysters were large and delicious, as the reviews said.

text:
If you’re looking for a hidden gem in Da Nang, DOM Bistro is the place. The atmosphere is intimate, with a distinctly European charm that makes you feel like you’ve stepped into a quiet corner of Spain or Italy.

The food is spot on – authentic Spanish and Italian flavors prepared with real finesse. The wine list is impressive, featuring bottles from Italy, France, and Spain. I paired a crisp South African white with their seafood dishes done in a German-inspired style, and it was a perfect match. Later in the evening, the baked specialties and rib eye came out, beautifully complemented by a 2023 Italian red wine.

DOM Bistro is more than just dinner – it’s a full European dining experience in the heart of Da Nang. Highly recommended for anyone who appreciates great wine, refined cooking, and a private, sophisticated setting.

text:
とてもよいです。
エビのサラダとダックプレストの照り焼き、ビール二本と赤ワインを一杯頂きました。
サラダのドレッシングは優しいけど味わいがあり、ダックも付け合わせ含めて美味しかった。
全体的に塩味が少なく私好みでした。
日本のファーストフードに慣れすぎていると味が薄いと感じる人がいるかも。

アルバイト店員の若い女性はニコニコ愛想がよいわけではないですが、とても真面目できちんと英語も通じますし、客にも気を配っています。
最初は入口近くの二人席を案内されましたが、しばらくして奥の4人席へ移動させてくれました。こういった配慮は嬉しいです。

雰囲気を満点にしなかったのは、大声で合唱、絶叫してパーティーをしている団体がいて、少し気になったため。部屋は分かれていたので、基本は問題ないと思います。
textTranslated:
It was very good.
We had the shrimp salad, teriyaki duck pudding, two beers, and a glass of red wine.
The salad dressing was mild but flavorful, and the duck, including the side dishes, was delicious.
Overall, it wasn't too salty, which I liked.
Some people who are used to Japanese fast food might find the taste a bit bland.
The young female part-time staff member wasn't overly cheerful or friendly, but she was very diligent, spoke good English, and was attentive to the customers.
Initially, we were seated at a two-person table near the entrance, but after a while, they moved us to a four-person table in the back. I appreciated this kind of consideration.

The reason I didn't give the atmosphere a perfect score is because there was a group singing and shouting loudly as they had a party, which was a bit distracting. However, they were in a separate room, so I think it's generally not a problem.

text:
Visited again on July 12, 2025 — actually our third time!

For dinner, we had Asahi beer and red wine, paired with a Caesar salad, mushroom soup, Japanese oysters, ragù pasta, steak, and panna cotta for dessert.

The Caesar salad had fresh, crisp vegetables and a well-balanced dressing. The mushroom soup is best enjoyed while warm — the aroma and richness of the mushrooms fill your mouth.

Right after that, we had fresh Japanese oysters. They were large, creamy, and incredibly satisfying. The lemon juice and finely chopped onions complemented them perfectly.

The ragù was tender and flavorful, and the steak was cooked to a perfect medium rare. Both dishes paired wonderfully with the red wine.

To finish, the panna cotta had a smooth texture and just the right amount of sweetness — a perfect end to the meal.

The ambiance is stylish and relaxed, and the owner is friendly and welcoming.
The food and atmosphere make us want to come back again. we’re already looking forward to our next visit!

—
June 22, 2025
We had a wonderful dinner here!
The lamb chops were perfectly cooked—tender, juicy, and full of flavor.
The fresh oysters were incredibly smooth and briny, just like the ocean.
For dessert, the panna cotta was silky and lightly sweet, the perfect ending to the meal.
Highly recommend this place for anyone looking for a refined yet relaxed dining experience in Da Nang.

text:
Our favorite meal in Vietnam!

I’m writing this review in hopes that you will find an opportunity to enjoy a fantastic meal at DOM Bistro like my family was fortunate to, on our first trip to Vietnam. Of all the places across the country we tried, this meal stands out as a top, unforgettable experience.

We sampled a few items from each course, and they were all delicious, many  in surprising ways. The beef carpaccio was especially fantastic, with a couple of us deciding to get another order of it ‘for dessert’ at the end of the meal. (I think I’d fly back to Da Nang just to eat this dish again, and to try the tuna carpaccio, which is probably similarly incredible.)

The juice drinks are refreshing, and the wine selection is top-notch, likely because the owner Mr. Dang, who we met, has a background in the wine industry.  Every aspect of this cozy, boutique restaurant and menu was great to experience, and my family hopes to come back again someday.

Maybe y’all can raise a glass and toast to everyone’s health and good fortune, to cap your own European/Viet/Fusion dining experience. (If you do go, please tell Mr Dang hello from Ken in the USA.  Enjoy!)

text: 一昨年の7月に続いて今回は6月、2度目の来店でした。一昨年の生牡蠣が美味しかったので、今回も！一昨年はプラス子羊（agneau)、チーズの盛り合わせを。今年はホタテ貝、海老、鮭、に同じくチーズの盛り合わせ。ガーリックバターで頂くパンも料理によく合います。冷えた白ワインに続き、赤ワインも。（一人なのでグラスで）料理もワインもとても美味しく頂きました。オーナーがワイン関連の仕事をされていた事もあり、ワインは他店と比べてリーズナブルです。フレンチレストランが高騰化してきている中、DOMはまさにビストロ！お勧めです！
textTranslated: This was my second visit, in June, following my first visit in July two years ago. I enjoyed the raw oysters so much last year that I ordered them again! Last year, I also had lamb (agneau) and a cheese platter. This year, I had scallops, shrimp, salmon, and the same cheese platter. The bread served with garlic butter also paired well with the dishes. I started with a chilled white wine, followed by a red wine (by the glass, as I was alone). Both the food and the wine were delicious. The owner used to work in the wine industry, so the wine is reasonably priced compared to other restaurants. While French restaurants are becoming increasingly expensive, DOM is truly a bistro! Highly recommended!

textTranslated: I stumbled upon this restaurant while looking for a nice restaurant in Vietnam. It's only 10 minutes from My Khe Beach, and the manager was so friendly that I had a great first impression. The salad was fresh, and the shrimp topping was delicious. The Bolognese spaghetti was hotel-quality, so I ordered extra spaghetti of the day and was delighted. The T-bone steak melted in my mouth. Even my parents, who are Korean food enthusiasts, loved it. Highly recommended. - Kim

text: ダナンに数あるイタリアン料理屋さんの中でもトップクラス。雰囲気は間違いなくNo.1。日本人の私としては、料理は少し甘口ですが、甘くしないでと頼んだら、できる限り要望を聞いてくれました。オーナーも英語堪能。従業員のJolyさんもとても美人で、お話上手です。ピアノがあり、他のお客様の了解があれば、上手い人は弾いても良いそうです。オーナー曰く、私のように、「シーザーサラダとビールだけでも気軽にカウンターに来てください」との事。新鮮ロメインレタス!+カリカリベーコン+大き目のクルトンにハマりました。
textTranslated: This is one of the best Italian restaurants in Da Nang. The atmosphere is undoubtedly the best. As a Japanese person, I find the food a little sweet, but when I asked for it to be less sweet, they accommodated my request as much as possible. The owner is fluent in English, and the staff member, Joly, is a beautiful woman and a great conversationalist. There's a piano, and if other customers have permission, talented musicians are welcome to play. The owner said, "Feel free to come to the counter just for a Caesar salad and beer," just like me. I was hooked on the fresh romaine lettuce, crispy bacon, and large croutons.

text:
와이프 생일에 미리 예약하고 갔습니다
자리는 2층에 단독으로 주셨고 따로 요청하지않으면 1층으로 자리잡아주는거 같습니다.
이 가게에 정석
600그람티본 카르보나라 단품 굴을 시켰습니다
1.
티본스테이크는 아이가있어서 미듐과 웰던으로 구워달라고 했는데 다른곳에선 해주지 않았지만
돔에선 무리없이 해주셨습니다 .
미듐으로 조리된 티본은 살짝오버 쿠킹된 부분이 있었지만 이건 티본 원물 조리 특성상.. 넘어가겠습니다 .
그 특성을 생각하면 상당히 굽기가 정확합니다.
다른 리뷰에도 극찬을 해주신
2.
카르보나라를 먹고 완벽히 생크림이 배제된 정석임을 깨닳았습니다.
치즈 노른자 후추로만 맛을 내어 아메리칸 카르보나라를 좋아하시면 추천 드립니다 ( 보편적인 한국 (생크림이 들어간 ) 카르보나라보다 간이 약하고 치즈 후추의맛을 잘느낄수있습니다 (베트남은 후추 생산국) )

3. 오이스터 쉘
단품으로 주문했습니다.  베트남 해산물 혹은 날것에 불안감을 느끼신다면 추천드리지 않습니다만...
그 불안함을  충분히 감안했을경우 합리적인 맛이라고 생각듭니다 .
자기주장 강한 굴의향과 맛 함께주시는 소스 그리고 간단한 레몬  강남 펄쉘보단 당연히 못미치지만 베트남에서 굴을 취급하는 곳중 생으로 먹을수있는곳  가격대비 합리적입니다.

또한 와인리스트는 휼륭하진않지만 가격대 카테고리를 잘 나눠놓았고 서비스 면이나 다른부분들이 좋았습니다 .
(한국어는 불가능하지만 영어가 어느정도 가능하고 번역기가 함께라면 무엇이 두려울까요?)
Ps 서버분에게 주문이나 필요한 요청을할시 2층은 다소 불편하긴합니다 ( 링벨 x )
Ps2. 물이... 차징인지 프리인지 모루겠네용
Ps3. 하우스와인도 가격대비 훌륭합니다..
가격은
식전빵 600gr 티본 카르보나라 굴 6피스
샴페인 1 보틀
총 260만동 나왔숩니다 대략 13만원이내요
textTranslated:
I made a reservation in advance for my wife's birthday. We were given a private table on the second floor, and unless you specifically request otherwise, you'll likely be seated on the first floor.

This restaurant is a classic.
We ordered a 600-gram T-bone carbonara and a single oyster.
1.
I asked for the T-bone steak to be cooked medium and well-done because I have a child with me. While other places haven't done it,
Dom's did it without a hitch.
The T-bone cooked medium was a bit overcooked, but that's the nature of T-bones, so I'll overlook that.
Considering that, the cooking was quite precise.

Other reviews have also praised this.
2.
After eating the carbonara, I realized it was a classic, completely devoid of whipped cream. If you like American carbonara, seasoned only with cheese, egg yolk, and pepper, I recommend it. (It's milder than the typical Korean carbonara (with whipped cream), but you can really taste the cheese and pepper flavor (Vietnam is a pepper producer).)

3. Oyster Shell
I ordered it as a single item. If you're nervous about Vietnamese seafood or raw food, I wouldn't recommend it...

But considering that concern, I think it's reasonably priced.
The sauce, which is accompanied by a strong oyster flavor and a simple lemon, is definitely not as good as Gangnam Pearl Shell, but it's one of the few places in Vietnam where you can eat oysters raw, and it's reasonably priced.

Although the wine list isn't the best, it's well-categorized by price range, and the service and other aspects were excellent.
(I don't speak Korean, but if you can speak some English and have a translator, what's there to fear?)
P. The second floor is a bit inconvenient for ordering or making requests to the server (no ringing bells).
P.2. Water... I can't tell if it's charged or free.
Ps3. The house wine is also excellent for the price.
The price is:
Appetizer bread 600gr T-bone carbonara 6-piece oyster
1 bottle of champagne
Total came to 2.6 million won, which is about 130,000 won.

text: OMG The food in this restaurant is to die for! We had tuna carpaccio, the mushroom soup (starters) then the sea bass followed by the panacotta. Truly I have never eaten a nicer sea bass, the sauce was subtle and delicious and complimented the perfectly cooked fish,    Creamed potatoes and red peppers broccolini.  The carpaccio was delicate and so tasty with capers and light rocket salad.  The soup was delicious and the panacotta fresh and light with a little hint of passion fruit which set it off beautifully.  We had a Villa Maria sav blanc which was a perfect match for our dinner.  We are so impressed we will definitely be back! The staff were so friendly and professional- it was a wonderful dining experience- The best in Danang for sure. We highly recommend you give this place a go - you wont regret it! 😊

text:
Tôi đã ghé thăm DOM nhiều lần, ấn tượng tốt của tôi đối với DOM là các món ăn đều tươi, không tẩm ướp quá nhiều và vẫn giữ lại độ tươi ngọt của thực phẩm khi chế biến. Đặc biệt là món T-Bone steak thơm ngon, miếng thịt mềm mại, bên ngoài chín vàng, bên trong hồng tươi, mọng nước, cảm giác như tan chảy khi thưởng thức kèm nước sốt, tỏi nướng, khoai tây nghiền cùng với ly vang đỏ.

Ngoài ra, ở DOM còn có các món khác tươi ngon mang đậm phong vị phương tây mà tôi đã từng thưởng thức như các loại salad, hàu tươi sống, beef pasta, T-Bone, tuna steak... với giá cả tương đối hợp lý. Không gian ở DOM tuy không được rộng rãi lắm, nhưng ấm cúng, có thể phù hợp với các buổi tiệc nhỏ, gặp gỡ gia đình, bạn bè....
textTranslated:
I've visited DOM many times, and my positive impression is that the food is fresh, not overly marinated, and retains the natural sweetness of the ingredients during cooking. The T-Bone steak is especially delicious; the meat is tender, golden brown on the outside, and juicy and pink on the inside, practically melting in your mouth when enjoyed with the sauce, roasted garlic, mashed potatoes, and a glass of red wine.

In addition, DOM offers other fresh and delicious Western-style dishes that I've tried, such as salads, fresh oysters, beef pasta, T-Bone steak, tuna steak, etc., all at relatively reasonable prices. While the space at DOM isn't very large, it's cozy and suitable for small parties, family gatherings, and get-togethers with friends.

We had such a thoughtful meal that we'd want to return for anniversaries, or even just for a little extra luxury.

후기 이벤트, 받은거 이런거 하나도 없지만 두고두고 기억하고 다낭 들릴때면 꼭 또 가기 위해! 더 번창하시고 더 오래오래 가게해주시라는 마음에서 진심을 다해 쓰는 후기예요! 또 가겠습니다!
textTranslated:
A restaurant I was genuinely happy to discover!

On that day, around 8:30, I suddenly felt like going, so I looked it up on Google Maps to get there, but it said they close at 10:30.

So, I sent a chat message asking if I could still have a meal since I could be there within 10 minutes.

Fortunately, they replied that they were open until 11:00 and said "see you soon," so I immediately called a Grab and flew over.

Although I have been to Da Nang many times, I went down an alley with a different atmosphere that I was visiting for the first time, and there it was: DOM!

I went inside and ordered a bottle of house white wine, along with lamb steak, oysters, and Bolognese pasta. The oysters came out first, and since they were incredibly expensive per piece (about 4,000 KRW), I only ordered two to start with...

It was a shock in itself...

They were so delicious... fresh... wow...

I absolutely love raw oysters and clams, but after moving to Seoul in Korea, I had a bad experience with raw oysters a few times, so I stopped eating them often.

However, I fell in love with oysters once again in a shocking way...

I devoured both of them right away and ordered two more immediately.

The oysters alone cost about 16,000 KRW, but the taste was totally justifiable...!! I was convinced that if this quality were in Korea, it would definitely have been twice as expensive, so I excitedly placed an additional order.

The Bolognese that came out next also didn't seem like a store-bought sauce no matter how much I tasted it; it seemed like it was homemade. However, I wasn't the type to ask questions about it, so I just quietly enjoyed eating it.

And then the lamb steak came out... It was so... delicious... Even though it's much more expensive in Korea, it doesn't taste like this... I was so happy that when I was almost finished, I ordered the exact same lamb steak again without hesitation. I definitely wasn't that hungry, though🤣

That's why if you look at the photos, the oysters and the steak look slightly different lol.

The owner gave us a little whiskey as a complimentary drink in the middle of the meal; it was a peated whiskey, something like Laphroaig or Talisker, and that was delicious too, making for a truly happy evening.

I didn't participate in any review events or receive anything like that, but I am writing this review with all my heart so that I can remember it forever and make sure to visit again whenever I stop by Da Nang! I hope you prosper and stay open for a long, long time! I will be back!

text:
후기 믿고 갔다가 실망했습니다.
일단 스테이크 메뉴 중에 안되는 메뉴가 몇있었고 주문한 스테이크 정말 별로였습니다. 어떤 부위냐에 따라 다르겠지만 일단 고기 손질이 잘 안되있어서 먹으면서 뱉어내는 부분이 좀 있었구요 소스자체가 별로였습니다.
함께 주문한 샐러드는 맛있었고 지인들이 파스타 맛있다길래 와봤는데 파스타 주문할걸 후회했어요..
와인도 글라스로 주문하는데 종류중에 80%가 없는 와인..
그럼 메뉴는 왜 해놨는지 ..
주문 하려는 메뉴가 왜 안되는지 스텝이 설명을 못합니다.
그냥 불가능하다는 말만 하니 이유를 모른채 다른 메뉴를 선택해야 했어요.
분위기 좋고 예쁜데 스테이크 가성비는 많이 떨어지네요.
손님도 한국 손님만 세 테이블 전부..
인기있는 로컬 스테이크매장 가면 같은 시간대 붐비는 거 비교해보면 많이 차이가 나요.
textTranslated:
I went there trusting the reviews, but I was disappointed.

First of all, several items on the steak menu were unavailable, and the steak I ordered was really bad. It might vary depending on the cut, but the meat wasn't prepared well, so I ended up spitting out parts while eating, and the sauce itself was poor.

The salad I ordered along with it was delicious, and I came here because friends said the pasta was good, but I regretted not ordering the pasta instead.

I also ordered wine by the glass, but 80% of the varieties were unavailable.

Then why did they even list them on the menu?

The staff couldn't explain why the items I wanted to order were unavailable.

They just kept saying it was impossible, so I had to choose something else without knowing the reason.

The atmosphere is nice and pretty, but the value for money for the steak is very poor.

All three tables were occupied by Korean customers.

If you compare this to popular local steak restaurants that are crowded at the same time, there is a huge difference.
